# ScopeSite Digital Studios - LLM Information File
# Learn more: https://llmstxt.org/

> ScopeSite Digital Studios is a veteran-owned, AI-first web design agency based in Somerset, UK. We specialize in making businesses visible to AI platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity through our proprietary V.O.I.C.E™ methodology.

## About Us
- **Company**: ScopeSite Digital Studios
- **Location**: Frome, Somerset, UK
- **Founded by**: Dan Cartwright (British Army Veteran)
- **Specialization**: AI-optimized web design, V.O.I.C.E™ AI visibility optimization
- **Target Market**: UK SMEs, service businesses

## Services
- **Web Design**: Server-side rendered (SSR) websites built on Next.js for maximum AI crawler visibility
- **V.O.I.C.E™ Optimization**: Proprietary methodology for AI platform visibility (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI)
- **Custom Web Apps**: Bespoke business applications, quote builders, client portals

## V.O.I.C.E™ Methodology
Our proprietary framework for AI visibility:
- **V**isibility: Making your business findable by AI assistants like ChatGPT, Siri, Alexa and Claude
- **O**ptimisation: Technical improvements to structured data, schema markup and site architecture
- **I**ntelligent: AI-focused strategy that goes beyond traditional SEO
- **C**onversational: Voice search ready - optimised for how people actually talk to AI
- **E**ngines: Built for ChatGPT, Siri, Alexa, Claude, Perplexity and whatever comes next
